title: Shi et al. 2025 — HEFMI-ICH: a hybrid EEG-fNIRS motor imagery dataset for brain-computer interface in intracerebral hemorrhage
description: HEFMI-ICH is a hybrid EEG-fNIRS motor imagery dataset for brain-computer interface research in intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH). It includes 37 participants (17 healthy, 20 ICH patients) who performed two-class left/right hand motor imagery across multiple sessions. The dataset supports development of BCI-based rehabilitation approaches for stroke patients.
methods_description: 32-channel EEG was recorded with a g.HIamp amplifier at 256 Hz. Participants performed left- or right-hand grasping motor imagery after a visual arrow cue with an auditory beep, with roughly 30 trials per session over up to three sessions. Data were preprocessed with a 0.5-30 Hz band-pass filter, and baseline classifiers (CSP+SVM, FBCSP+SVM, EEGBaseNet, TF+SVM) were evaluated with 5-fold within-subject cross-validation.
